_about: Log of every job seen by the job search (submitted / skipped / needs approval / needs user / pending / candidate). Single source of truth since 2026-10-13 (migrated from applications.md). Check it before every application (python applog.py check "<company>" "<role>") and add/update entries with python applog.py add ... --url <job link>. Every entry keeps the job link in "url": the company's posting / application page for Submitted jobs (required), otherwise the LinkedIn post; "" = link unknown (older entries) - python applog.py list --no-link shows them. Never store .env values here.

jobs.notes: ATS used, salary asked, anything to remember
